name: ibis Styles Jakarta Mangga Dua Square
short_description: A 211-room economy hotel with vibrant pop-art murals in North Jakarta, a 5-minute walk from Mangga Dua Square mall and shared pool access next door at Novotel.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Jakarta Mangga Dua Square is a 211-room economy hotel in North Jakarta, distinguished by its vibrant pop-art mural design and its position a short walk from Mangga Dua Square shopping mall and the wider Mangga Dua electronics district. Guests share pool access with the adjacent Novotel Jakarta Mangga Dua Square and can eat at the on-site sTREATs restaurant. Reviews consistently praise the affordable rates, clean rooms, and friendly staff for a three-star property, with Ancol and Jakarta Kota train station both a short ride away. A minority of reviews flag housekeeping lapses in corridors and rooms, which the hotel has responded to directly.

pros: 5-minute walk to Mangga Dua Square mall and the Mangga Dua electronics district
Shared access to an Olympic-size swimming pool at the adjacent Novotel
Distinctive, colorful pop-art mural design throughout the property
Strong value for money on a three-star budget
Friendly, attentive staff noted across guest reviews
cons: A minority of guests report housekeeping or pest issues in rooms and corridors
No swimming pool of its own -- pool access is via the neighboring Novotel
research_highlights: Guests consistently call out clean rooms, friendly service, and good value for a budget-tier hotel
The Mangga Dua Square location is repeatedly cited as convenient for shopping and North Jakarta business
The hotel has invested in sustainability, including an on-site filtered water system launched in 2024 to cut single-use plastic
research_watchouts: At least one guest review reported a pest issue in-room during a multi-night stay, which the property acknowledged and said it followed up on with housekeeping
The hotel's own pool is not confirmed -- pool access is shared with the adjacent Novotel Jakarta Mangga Dua Square, not a separate ibis Styles facility

faqs.question: Does ibis Styles Jakarta Mangga Dua Square have a swimming pool?
faqs.answer: Guests get access to an Olympic-size swimming pool located at the adjacent Novotel Jakarta Mangga Dua Square, since the two hotels share facilities on the same site. The ibis Styles property itself does not operate a separate standalone pool of its own.

faqs.question: How far is ibis Styles Jakarta Mangga Dua Square from the airport?
faqs.answer: The hotel is roughly a 28 to 30 minute drive from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport, depending on Jakarta traffic. It's more centrally positioned for North Jakarta attractions, sitting about 5 minutes on foot from Mangga Dua Square and around 9 minutes from Ancol and JIExpo Kemayoran.
